text:
I’m still not fluent in Hebrew, even after many years, but I don’t think that’s because I lack ability. For me, it’s more about motivation. Going to an ulpan would take too many resources, both in time and money.

What has worked for me is something called Piece of Hebrew. There’s plenty of free content on YouTube, and if you want more structure, for less than $10 a month they also have a website with lessons and a monthly meeting. That setup can help keep you accountable, since it pushes you to do some homework and speak with other students.

There are also other short stories on YouTube with subtitles and explanations, which are great for following along and improving your reading.

This isn’t sponsored at all — I’m just sharing something that has genuinely worked for me :)
